description: This file defines a Preferences dialog class for the BORIS software, handling user preferences, plugin management, and UI interactions.

classes.name: Preferences
classes.description: A QDialog subclass implementing the preferences window for BORIS, including plugin management, color resets, and configuration updates.

methods.name: browse_plugins_dir
methods.description: Opens a directory dialog to select personal plugins directory and updates the plugin list.

methods.name: refresh_preferences
methods.description: Prompts user to refresh preferences, potentially deleting the config file.

methods.name: browseFFmpegCacheDir
methods.description: Opens a directory dialog to select FFmpeg cache directory.

methods.name: reset_behav_colors
methods.description: Resets behavioral plot colors to default.
